description: This file implements the Gradium speech-to-text (STT) service integrated via WebSocket. It manages WebSocket connection setup, audio data streaming, message handling, and transcription processing, providing real-time speech transcription capabilities through Gradium's API.

classes.name: GradiumSTTService
classes.description: A class implementing real-time speech-to-text functionality via Gradium's WebSocket API, extending WebsocketSTTService, managing connection lifecycle, audio streaming, and transcription events.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, api_endpoint_base_url: str = "wss://eu.api.gradium.ai/api/speech/asr", json_config: str | None = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the GradiumSTTService with API credentials, endpoint, optional JSON config, and parent class parameters.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Indicates whether the service supports metrics generation (returns True).

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Starts the speech-to-text process, establishing WebSocket connection and initializing buffer sizes.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the speech-to-text process, disconnects WebSocket, and halts streaming.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Cancels ongoing operations and disconnects from WebSocket.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Processes incoming audio bytes by chunking and sending over WebSocket, yielding control for asynchronous operation.

methods.name: _trace_transcription(self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Language)
methods.description: Records transcription data for tracing/logging purposes (currently a stub).

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts message reception.

methods.name: _connect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Connects to the WebSocket endpoint, performs setup handshake, and awaits readiness message.

methods.name: _disconnect(self)
methods.description: Terminates WebSocket connection and cancels message receiving tasks.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection safely, handles errors, and signals disconnection events.

methods.name: _get_websocket(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the active WebSocket object or raises an error if not connected.

methods.name: _process_messages(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes incoming WebSocket messages, parsing JSON and handling different message types.

methods.name: _receive_messages(self)
methods.description: Continuously listens for WebSocket messages, reconnecting if disconnected.

methods.name: _process_response(self, msg)
methods.description: Handles different types of server responses, such as text transcriptions, end of stream, or errors.

methods.name: _handle_end_of_stream(self)
methods.description: Processes end of stream message from server.

methods.name: _handle_text(self, text: str)
methods.description: Processes transcription text, pushing it as a frame and possibly tracing it.
